description: Defines the class google_breakpad::LinuxCoreDumper for extracting crash information from core dumps on Linux systems, including methods for building proc paths, copying data from processes, and managing thread info.

classes.name: LinuxCoreDumper
classes.description: A class for post-mortem crash dump analysis on Linux, derived from LinuxDumper, handling core dump files and associated proc files.

methods.name: LinuxCoreDumper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dumper with process ID, core dump path, procfs path, and optional root prefix.

methods.name: BuildProcPath
methods.description: Builds a path to a specific proc file node for the process, ignoring the actual pid due to post-mortem context.

methods.name: CopyFromProcess
methods.description: Copies data from the core dump or fills with markers if data is missing.

methods.name: GetThreadInfoByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves information about a thread from the core dump by index.

methods.name: IsPostMortem
methods.description: Indicates this is a post-mortem dump.

methods.name: ThreadsSuspend
methods.description: No operation for post-mortem dump; always returns true.

methods.name: ThreadsResume
methods.description: No operation for post-mortem dump; always returns true.

methods.name: EnumerateThreads
methods.description: Enumerates all threads from the core dump.
